intro: Recorded in rainforests, rivers and volcanoes, cleaned and tuned in the studio. Sounds and tools for producers, sound designers and sound healers who want the living Earth inside their music.

items.title: Ocarinas
items.text: Clay ocarinas recorded up close: breath, whistle and call, with singing bowls and chalices around them. Ready to play.

items.title: Rainforest at dawn
items.text: Howler monkeys, birds and insects, from first light to full chorus.

items.title: Volcano and river
items.text: Deep rumbles, water textures and stones, ready to layer.

items.title: Pod
items.text: Whale-like calls that glide, and a second whale that answers. Call and response, never the same twice.

items.title: Place Tuner
items.text: Turns a place's recordings into its own musical scale, so every instrument plays in the intervals the land or the pod sings.

items.title: Breath Clock
items.text: An LFO that breathes: box breath, 4-7-8 or coherent breathing, mapped to any parameter in your set.

items.title: Sound Healing Journey
items.text: A ready 60-minute journey: arrival, grounding, deepening and return, with drones, bowls, monochord, binaural glides and nature beds. Open it and hold the space.

items.title: Breath & Nervous System Set
items.text: Four states, Activate, Pause & Realign, Relax and Sleep, each with its own breath pace, pulse and nature layer.

items.title: Generative Soundscape
items.text: A self-playing set for studios, spas and installations: birds, water, whales and harmony that move from dawn to night, never the same twice.

hero.title: Sound design from the living Earth

titles.custom_text: For films, games, installations and albums.
